# PartialArgValue

@Serializable

sealed interface [PartialArgValue](index.html)

Represents one of the possible values within a [PartialArg](../-partial-arg/index.html).

This sealed interface ensures that only one value type (boolean, number, string, or null) can be represented at a time.
